messages.subject: Request for photos
parts:
Dear distance-sampling list members,

Many of you use Distance 3.5, and are aware of the photographs that liven up
the Project Setup and Data Import wizards. As part of finalizing Distance 4.0,
I'd like to include some new photos in the software. So, does anyone have any
digital pictures depicting distance sampling that I can use? Suitable topics
include: wildlife photos, people doing distance surveys, sampling equipment
(binoculars, tape, etc), and sampling vehicles (boats, planes, etc).

If you have any photos that we would use, or know of any public domain
sources of suitable photos, please drop me an e-mail: l...@mcs.st-and.ac.uk
(do not reply to the list!). Full acknowledgements will, of course be given
in the program.

Thanks for any help,

- Len Thomas


--
Len Thomas, Co-ordinator
Distance Development Project
Research Unit for Wildlife Population Assessment
Mathematical Institute, University of St Andrews
Scotland KY16 9SS
